verified_fact_spans.anchor: Policy hot-reload mutates the route/priority indices
verified_fact_spans.source_line: Sticky-shard pointer (in-memory bucket reference) is validated only by shard id but not by tenant id during fast-path credit application. Policy hot-reload mutates the route/priority indices while a shard transfer copies pointers; combined these can produce a transient pointer that points at an unrelated tenant's bucket. Enforcement fast-path accepts the cache without full tenant-level validation.

verified_fact_spans.anchor: ensure the final successful attempt is the only billable
verified_fact_spans.source_line: 2026-02-09 08:06 PT — Cole Summers (Billing Hooks) — Root cause found: on stream retry/fallback, we emit a usage event on the first attempt when the stream aborts, then emit another usage event on the retry attempt. Downstream billing aggregation does not enforce "single billable event per (account_id, idempotency_key, api_operation)" and treats both as billable. We should mark the first attempt as non-billable (or billable=false, attempt_status=aborted) and ensure the final successful attempt is the only billable event under idempotency.
